articles.title: Spain Launches Gambling Player Portal Ahead of Cross-Operator Deposit Limits
articles.excerpt: Spain has launched a centralised player portal and is testing nationwide online-gambling deposit limits of €700 a day, €1,750 a week and €3,300 over four weeks.

articles.title: Italy Seizes More Than €25m in Assets in Scratchcard Fraud Case
articles.excerpt: Italian authorities have seized assets worth more than €25 million in a case involving five former lottery-concessionaire employees accused of identifying winning scratchcards.

articles.title: Utah Sues Kalshi and Susquehanna Firms Over Alleged Illegal Gambling
articles.excerpt: Utah has filed a lawsuit against Kalshi and Susquehanna businesses, asking a state court to halt allegedly unlawful event contracts.

articles.title: Ohio Warns Gambling Licensees to Cut Ties With Unlicensed Prediction Markets
articles.excerpt: Ohio gambling regulators have told sports betting and fantasy licensees to cease services to unlicensed prediction markets by October 30.

articles.title: Namibia Advances Gambling Regulation Proposals and Digital Monitoring Plan
articles.excerpt: Namibia is consulting on amended gambling and lottery regulations, including revised levies and a central electronic monitoring system.

articles.title: Boyd Gaming Reports $990.5m Third-Quarter Revenue as Online Segment Grows
articles.excerpt: Boyd Gaming reported $990.5m of Q3 2026 revenue, with online casino growth offsetting some softness in Las Vegas destination business.

articles.title: Police Uncover Two Illegal Casinos in Melbourne in Wider Investigation
articles.excerpt: Victoria Police uncovered alleged illegal casinos in Carnegie and Box Hill in a wider investigation that has led to 29 arrests.

articles.title: Police Raid 101 Poker Club in Katy, Texas, as Questions Remain Over Cause
articles.excerpt: Police raided 101 Poker Club in Katy, Texas, on 22 October. Staff were detained and at least one arrest was reported; the grounds remain unconfirmed.

articles.title: Australia Warns Former AFL Players Over Vegastars Casino Advertising
articles.excerpt: Australia’s ACMA issued formal warnings to former AFL players Mitch Robinson and Rhys Mathieson for promoting prohibited gambling site Vegastars.

articles.title: PointsBet Agrees Two-Day Ontario Suspension in Jontay Porter Betting Case
articles.excerpt: PointsBet Canada has agreed to a two-day Ontario gambling-site suspension and an independent compliance audit in a settlement with the AGCO.

articles.title: US Lawmakers Question VIP Rewards at Six Gambling and Prediction Platforms
articles.excerpt: Three US lawmakers sought details of VIP rewards, personalised promotions and AI use from six gambling and prediction-market companies by 5 November.

articles.title: Tether.bet Curaçao Licence Application Questioned in Newspaper Investigation
articles.excerpt: A Times investigation alleges irregularities in documents used to support Tether.bet’s Curaçao gambling licence application. The claims are not regulatory findings.

articles.title: Evoke Q3 Revenue Falls 7% as William Hill Shop Closures Reach 270
articles.excerpt: Evoke reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of £406 million, down 7%, as retail closures and sports results weighed on trading.

articles.title: UK Gambling Commission Sets Out Good Practice for Sports Micro-Betting Settlements
articles.excerpt: The UK Gambling Commission has outlined expectations for bookmakers and data suppliers when sporting micro-events are used to settle bets.

articles.title: CFTC Asks Novig and ProphetX to Hold Back Sports Event Contracts
articles.excerpt: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission has raised objections to proposed sports event contracts from Novig and ProphetX, with the exchanges given an opportunity to respond.

articles.title: Evolution Temporarily Closes Brazil Live Casino Studio Amid Regulatory Uncertainty
articles.excerpt: Evolution has temporarily shut its Brazilian live casino studio as uncertainty over the country’s gambling framework continues, the supplier confirmed in its third-quarter results.

articles.title: Greece Recruits 40 Gambling Inspectors to Strengthen Enforcement
articles.excerpt: Greece’s Hellenic Gaming Commission is recruiting 40 inspectors from the public sector, with applications closing on 6 November 2026.

articles.title: South Africa to Announce Online Gambling Tax Design in February 2027
articles.excerpt: South Africa’s finance minister says the government will announce the final design of a proposed national online gambling tax in February 2027, with consultations still underway.

articles.title: Italian Retail Gambling Operators Seek Extension Before December Licence Expiry
articles.excerpt: Italian betting, bingo and gaming-machine concessions are due to expire at the end of 2026, prompting calls for transitional measures as land-based gambling reform remains delayed.

articles.title: Buenos Aires Senator Proposes Ban on Online Casinos and Sports Betting
articles.excerpt: Buenos Aires provincial senator Federico Fagioli has proposed legislation to prohibit online sports betting, casino games and poker, replacing the province’s existing licensing framework.

articles.title: Chile Senator Proposes Prison Terms of Up to 15 Years for Illegal Online Gambling
articles.excerpt: Senate president Paulina Núñez has proposed tougher penalties, permanent judicial blocking and restrictions on financing and advertising illegal online gambling in Chile.

articles.title: Latvia Committee Advances Gambling Age 21 and Player Tracking Proposals
articles.excerpt: A Latvian parliamentary committee backed gambling reform proposals including a minimum age of 21, gaming-hall closing hours and personalised player tracking.

articles.title: Denmark Advances Bill to Restrict Gambling Advertising Around Live Sport
articles.excerpt: Denmark’s gambling reform bill L37 would restrict gambling ads around live sports, impose limits on influencers and expand regulator enforcement powers.

articles.title: PrizePicks Launches Digital Card Packs With $8.04m Cooper Flagg Card
articles.excerpt: PrizePicks has launched paid digital trading-card packs with physical cards among the possible prizes, including a Cooper Flagg card sold for $8.04 million.

articles.title: High Roller Launches ROLR Prediction Markets for Eligible US Customers
articles.excerpt: High Roller Technologies has launched its ROLR prediction-markets platform commercially, offering event contracts through Crypto.com Derivatives North America.

articles.title: Ohio Warns Gaming Licensees Over Prediction Market Relationships
articles.excerpt: Ohio regulators have told sports betting and fantasy gaming licensees to end support for unlicensed sports event contracts and confirm compliance by October 30.

articles.title: IG Group Plans UK Prediction Markets and Applies for Gambling Licence
articles.excerpt: IG Group plans to launch financial prediction markets for UK professional clients in late 2026 and is pursuing a gambling licence for sports, politics and entertainment markets.

articles.title: Betsson Reports Record Q3 Revenue as Operating Profit Falls 31%
articles.excerpt: Betsson reported record quarterly revenue of €326.5 million, but operating profit fell 31% to €46.1 million during the third quarter of 2026.

articles.title: FDJ UNITED Cuts 2026 Outlook and Reviews Online Gambling Markets
articles.excerpt: FDJ UNITED has lowered its 2026 targets after nine-month revenue fell 5.6%, and is reviewing online gambling markets and non-core assets.

articles.title: New Brunswick Reviews Opening Online Gambling to Private Operators
articles.excerpt: New Brunswick is examining whether to regulate private online casinos and sportsbooks, potentially changing Atlantic Lottery’s role. No market opening has been approved.

articles.title: Jeju Casino Faces Proposed Three-Month Suspension Over Marked-Card Blackjack Case
articles.excerpt: Jeju authorities are considering a three-month suspension after six casino-linked people were referred to prosecutors in an alleged marked-card blackjack fraud case.

articles.title: Polymarket Reportedly Dismisses Marketing Chief Matthew Modabber
articles.excerpt: The New York Post reports Polymarket dismissed marketing executive Matthew Modabber following an internal review of controversial promotional practices. The claims remain independently unverified.

articles.title: EU Court Sets November 19 Judgment Date in Malta Bill 55 Case
articles.excerpt: The EU Court of Justice is scheduled to rule on November 19 in a case involving Malta’s restrictions on enforcement of foreign judgments against licensed gambling operators.

articles.title: Pentagon Bars Prediction-Market Trades Using Nonpublic Military Information
articles.excerpt: A US Defense Department directive bars military and civilian personnel from trading on prediction markets using nonpublic information about military operations.

articles.title: Dutch Gambling Regulator Fines EOD Code €37 Million Over Illegal Casinos
articles.excerpt: The Dutch gambling regulator has fined EOD Code SRL €37 million for offering online gambling without a Dutch licence, citing multiple websites and player-protection failures.

articles.title: New Jersey Makes Data-Driven Responsible Gambling Rules Mandatory
articles.excerpt: New Jersey’s online gambling rules took effect on October 19, requiring player-risk reviews, phased interventions and restrictions on marketing to at-risk customers.

articles.title: QuintAce and AceGuardian Open-Source Poker Superuser Detection Software
articles.excerpt: QuintAce and AceGuardian Research have released open-source poker superuser detection software that looks for suspicious hidden-card-informed decisions, not just high win rates.

articles.title: LCKY Group Completes RoyalCasino Acquisition, Adding Three Danish Casino Brands
articles.excerpt: LCKY Group has confirmed the completed takeover of RoyalCasino, bringing RoyalCasino, KapowCasino and ValhallaCasino into its Danish-facing online casino portfolio.

articles.title: Press Association Agrees A$49.8m Acquisition of Racing Data Firm RAS Technology
articles.excerpt: The PA has agreed to acquire Australia-listed RAS Technology for A$1.04 per share, bringing Racing and Sports alongside its Podium data business if approvals are secured.

articles.title: L&L Europe to Pay £900,000 After UKGC Finds Withdrawal and AML Failures
articles.excerpt: The UK Gambling Commission has announced a £900,000 regulatory settlement with L&L Europe following findings over withdrawal delays, anti-money laundering controls and safer gambling.

articles.title: Bryn Kenney Sues GGPoker-Linked Companies Over Alleged 5% Equity Promise
articles.excerpt: Poker professional Bryn Kenney alleges he was denied a promised 5% equity interest and commissions linked to player recruitment. GGPoker-linked defendants are contesting the case.

articles.title: Raketech Agrees €8.2m Settlement of €20.3m Casumba Earnout Liability
articles.excerpt: Raketech has agreed to settle its remaining Casumba earnout liability for €8.2 million, subject to bank funding, against approximately €20.3 million payable under existing terms.

articles.title: Brennan Center Study Finds Election Prediction Markets Shape Voters’ Expectations
articles.excerpt: A Brennan Center-funded experiment involving 1,994 registered voters found that prediction-market odds changed expectations about election winners, despite public scepticism.

articles.title: Connecticut Man Pleads Guilty After $1.16m Crypto Fraud Funds Were Gambled on Stake
articles.excerpt: A Connecticut man admitted fraud and money-laundering offences after diverting investors’ cryptocurrency to Stake.com, according to US prosecutors.

articles.title: Turkish Football Federation Suspends 147 Officials in Betting Disciplinary Cases
articles.excerpt: Turkey’s football federation issued 45-day suspensions to 147 football officials in a new round of disciplinary decisions involving betting.

articles.title: GGPoker Bans Third-Party Poker Software and Adds New Security Controls
articles.excerpt: GGPoker has announced a broad ban on third-party poker software alongside new client security tools, win-rate anomaly monitoring and an end to legacy operating-system support.

articles.title: UKGC Research Examines Why Players Use Illegal Gambling Websites
articles.excerpt: New UK Gambling Commission research finds that consumer engagement with illegal gambling sites has varied motivations, with “not on Gamstop” searches emerging as a wider gateway.

articles.title: Brazil Flags 20,318 Illegal Betting Websites and Promotional Channels for Blocking
articles.excerpt: Brazil says 16,627 betting websites and 3,691 promotional channels have been identified for blocking or removal after its nationwide betting prohibition.

articles.title: Kalshi Ether Futures Analysis Questions Explanation for $9.81 Billion in Trades
articles.excerpt: An analysis of 5.35 million Kalshi ether-futures trades found $9.81 billion in concentrated fixed-size transactions and questions the exchange's market-maker explanation, without establishing misconduct.

articles.title: TikTok Shop Restricts Random Trading-Card Breaks to Its Own Surprise Set Tool
articles.excerpt: TikTok Shop limits random-team trading-card breaks to eligible US sellers using its Surprise Set tool and prohibits external randomization, amid scrutiny of gambling-like collectible sales.

articles.title: Australia Clarifies Ban on Celebrities and Athletes in Gambling Ads From 2027
articles.excerpt: Australia's ACMA has published guidance on restrictions barring athletes, celebrities, influencers and other prominent people from gambling advertising from 1 January 2027.

articles.title: South Korean Police Disrupt Network Behind 188 Illegal Gambling Sites
articles.excerpt: South Korean police say a cross-border supply network produced 188 illegal gambling websites involving KRW23 trillion in bets, with 77 people apprehended and 21 detained.

articles.title: Hippos ATG Announces Finnish Gambling Licence Ahead of 2027 Market Opening
articles.excerpt: ATG and Suomen Hippos say their joint venture has secured a licence to offer horse racing betting, sports betting and online casino games when Finland’s new market opens in July 2027.

articles.title: Louisiana Extends DraftKings Sports Betting Permit for Four Months
articles.excerpt: Louisiana regulators conditionally extended DraftKings’ sports betting permit through 19 February 2027 while reviewing shareholder suitability and questions about its AI and prediction-market activities.

articles.title: Polymarket Challenges Ohio Sports-Betting Rules in Federal Court
articles.excerpt: Polymarket US has filed a federal challenge following Ohio’s crackdown on sports event contracts, with reporting pointing to a new Commerce Clause argument over in-state licensing requirements.

articles.title: Canada Bars Sports Prediction Contracts on Investment Dealer Platforms
articles.excerpt: CIRO has prohibited investment dealers from offering or displaying sports and entertainment event contracts, while permitting some financial, economic and environmental contracts under strict conditions.

articles.title: CFTC Excludes Traditional Sportsbook Bets From Swaps as New Rule Takes Effect
articles.excerpt: A CFTC interim final rule effective 19 October excludes qualifying casino and sportsbook products from the federal swaps definition, while a separate proposal addresses event contracts.

articles.title: Flutter Plans Up to 1,400 Job Cuts as UK Gambling Taxes Rise
articles.excerpt: Flutter Entertainment has proposed up to 1,400 redundancies across its UK and Ireland business and support hubs in Portugal and Romania, citing higher UK gambling taxes.

articles.title: Catena Media Revenue Falls 29% as Search Disruption Hits Gambling Affiliate Business
articles.excerpt: Catena Media reported preliminary Q3 2026 revenue of €8.3 million, down 29%, and abandoned its annual growth targets amid search disruption and weaker operator spending.

articles.title: Betdaq Exchange to Close on 21 October After Matchbook Acquires Brand
articles.excerpt: Betdaq will end exchange trading on 21 October 2026 after Matchbook acquired its brand and domains. Customer accounts will remain accessible for withdrawals until 4 November.

articles.title: ESIC Imposes Lifetime Counter-Strike Ban on 2xplayN Following Further Integrity Breaches
articles.excerpt: ESIC has escalated Palkovics “2xplayN” Tamás’s three-year Counter-Strike sanction to lifetime ineligibility following additional conduct after the NOMERCY match-manipulation investigation.

articles.title: 888poker Launches in Alberta as PokerStars Ends International Poker Access
articles.excerpt: 888poker opened Alberta’s first locally regulated online poker room on October 13, the same day PokerStars stopped serving Alberta through its international poker platform.

articles.title: Brazil Betting Ban Forces Licensed Sportsbooks and Online Casinos Offline
articles.excerpt: Brazil ordered fixed-odds sports betting and covered online casino platforms offline from 6 October under Provisional Measure 1,394/2026, while remaining player balances entered a mandated refund process.

articles.title: Polymarket Removes Cornell Criminal-Charges Market Following Backlash
articles.excerpt: Polymarket removed a controversial international-platform contract about possible criminal charges in the Cornell sexual-assault case after public criticism. Front Office Sports reported $451,633 in trading volume before removal.

articles.title: QQPK Bans 893 Accounts and Establishes $300,000 Fund After Poker Collusion Investigation
articles.excerpt: QQPK says it banned 893 accounts after detecting a coordinated poker cheating operation and allocated $300,000 for affected players, while outside researchers continue to question the scope of the problem.

articles.title: Novig and Crypto.com Sue Missouri Over Sports Prediction-Market Restrictions
articles.excerpt: Novig and Crypto.com’s derivatives exchange filed separate federal lawsuits seeking to block Missouri’s enforcement of sports betting rules against event contracts.

articles.title: Comoros Seeks UK Help Over Disputed Anjouan Gambling Licences
articles.excerpt: Comorian authorities are challenging an Anjouan offshore gambling licensing network and seeking UK cooperation, according to an investigation published on 19 October.

articles.title: New York Advances AI Promotion Limits and Sports Betting Safeguards
articles.excerpt: New York regulators advanced proposals to restrict AI-targeted betting promotions and require sportsbooks to identify and support at-risk customers.

articles.title: Coinbase Agrees to Halt Sports Prediction Markets in Michigan
articles.excerpt: Coinbase agreed to halt sports event contracts in Michigan by October 10 while litigation over state and federal authority continues.

articles.title: Spain Extends Gambling Risk-Detection Consultation to October 26
articles.excerpt: Spain’s DGOJ has extended consultation on its proposed common system for detecting risky online gambling behaviour to 23:59 on October 26, 2026.

articles.title: France Online Gambling GGR Rises 11% as Wider Market Growth Stalls
articles.excerpt: French online gambling GGR reached €1.45 billion in H1 2026, up 11%, while the wider market rose just 0.5%, ANJ data show. Active online player accounts hit 5.85 million.

articles.title: New Jersey Underage Gambling Bill Advances With Civil Fines Up to $2,000
articles.excerpt: New Jersey Senate Bill 597 cleared the Judiciary Committee 11–0 on October 15. It would replace certain criminal penalties for underage gambling with civil fines and fund addiction prevention.

articles.title: FIFA Partner ADI Predictstreet Faces Questions Over $108M in Linked-Wallet Trading
articles.excerpt: A Wall Street Journal investigation found that about $108 million of $167 million in ADI Predictstreet trading through late September involved wallets apparently linked to the platform. Gibraltar’s regulator said its preliminary review found compliance.

articles.title: AGA Study Finds Prediction-Market Users Overestimate Their Math Skills
articles.excerpt: AGA-commissioned research published September 25 finds gamblers score higher on financial literacy, while prediction-market users show a confidence gap in math skills.

articles.title: French Study Finds 39% of Teens Play Games With Gambling-Like Features
articles.excerpt: France’s ANJ says 39% of 15–17-year-olds played hybrid digital games in 2025, with spending and betting-ad exposure raising concerns.

articles.title: Crypto.com and Novig Sue Missouri Over Prediction-Market Crackdown
articles.excerpt: Crypto.com’s exchange and Novig filed separate federal lawsuits challenging Missouri’s effort to regulate sports event contracts as sports betting.

articles.title: Louisiana Extends DraftKings License Amid AI and Responsible Gambling Scrutiny
articles.excerpt: Louisiana regulators have extended DraftKings’ sports betting authorization through February 19, 2027, while reviewing shareholder suitability, AI-related allegations and responsible gambling controls.

articles.title: Underdog Sues Tennessee Over Sports Prediction-Market Crackdown
articles.excerpt: Underdog has sued Tennessee officials after a cease-and-desist letter targeting sports event contracts, testing the boundary between federal derivatives oversight and state wagering law.

articles.title: Shane Hennen Pleads Guilty in NCAA, NBA and Chinese Basketball Betting Cases
articles.excerpt: Sports gambler Shane Hennen pleaded guilty to bribery, fraud and money-laundering charges tied to NCAA and Chinese basketball game-fixing and NBA insider-information betting.

articles.title: NBA Restricts Player Under Parlays and Opening-Tip Bets at Partner Sportsbooks
articles.excerpt: The NBA has directed partner sportsbooks to remove selected player prop parlays, opening-tip wagers and other markets it considers vulnerable to manipulation.

articles.title: Stake, Entain and SkyCity Advance in New Zealand Online Casino Licence Auction
articles.excerpt: New Zealand has named 11 successful auction participants entitled to apply for 15 online casino licences, including companies linked to Stake, Entain, SkyCity and Betway.

articles.title: Pennsylvania Skill-Game Deadline Arrives as Police Prepare October 14 Enforcement
articles.excerpt: Pennsylvania businesses have until October 13 to remove unlicensed skill-game machines before police enforcement can begin on October 14.

articles.title: Turkey Detains 59 in Illegal Betting Probe Involving ₺7 Billion in Transactions
articles.excerpt: Turkish authorities detained 59 suspects in an illegal online betting investigation spanning eight provinces, citing ₺7 billion in account transactions.

articles.title: Coinbase Agrees to End Sports Prediction Contracts in Michigan
articles.excerpt: Coinbase agreed to stop new sports-related event contracts in Michigan and close open positions by 10 October, following state action against prediction-market platforms.

articles.title: Michigan Orders 33 Offshore Gambling Operators to Stop Serving Residents
articles.excerpt: Michigan has issued cease-and-desist letters to 33 offshore gambling operators, warning that unlicensed sites bypass the state’s self-exclusion safeguards.

articles.title: Brandon Wilson Wins Super High Roller Bowl XI for $1.125 Million
articles.excerpt: Brandon Wilson defeated Nick Petrangelo to win Super High Roller Bowl XI in Las Vegas, collecting $1,125,000 after surviving a near-elimination on the bubble.

articles.title: Greece Scrutinises VIP Gamblers as Unified Verification Plan Stalls
articles.excerpt: Greece’s gambling regulator has reportedly asked 18 licensed operators for details of VIP customer benefits, while a unified identification initiative faces a legal obstacle.

articles.title: Seminole Tribe Sues DraftKings Over Prediction Markets in Florida
articles.excerpt: The Seminole Tribe of Florida has sued DraftKings over prediction markets and Pick6, alleging the products violate its exclusive sports-betting rights. DraftKings denies the claims.

articles.title: Brazil Investigates 14 Betting Operators Over Revenue Declarations
articles.excerpt: Brazil's Finance Ministry is investigating 14 betting operators over suspected underreporting of revenue, according to Folha de S.Paulo. Blaze is among the businesses identified.

articles.title: BetMGM Q3 Revenue Rises 7% to $710 Million as Alberta Launch Expands Operations
articles.excerpt: BetMGM reported $710 million in third-quarter 2026 revenue, a 7% increase, and said its Alberta launch was performing strongly. Average monthly active players fell 3%.

articles.title: French Regulator Finds High-Risk Players Dominate Stakes in Certain Betting Markets
articles.excerpt: France’s gambling regulator says players classified as excessive account for more than 80% of stakes in certain lower-profile football leagues and 80–89% on some period-result bets.

articles.title: Spain Opens Consultation on Gambling Risk-Detection Mechanism
articles.excerpt: Spain’s gambling regulator has opened a public consultation on a proposed mechanism for identifying risky gambling behaviour. Comments are due by 22 October 2026.

articles.title: Spain to Require Payment Account Ownership Checks for Online Gambling
articles.excerpt: Spain's Royal Decree 813/2026 will require online gambling operators to verify that payment methods belong to the gambling account holder, with transitional rules for existing customers.

articles.title: New Zealand Names 11 Online Casino Licence Auction Winners
articles.excerpt: New Zealand has named 11 successful online casino auction bidders competing for 15 licences, with application rights priced at NZ$15 million each.

articles.title: Michigan Sends Cease-and-Desist Letters to 33 Offshore Gambling Operators
articles.excerpt: Michigan's gambling regulator has issued cease-and-desist letters to 33 offshore operators over unlicensed gambling services.

articles.title: Age of Empires Esports in 2026: Tournaments, Prize Pools and Competitive Scene
articles.excerpt: Age of Empires II and Age of Empires IV remain active esports titles in 2026, with World’s Edge-sponsored tournaments running across separate competitive circuits.
